brief.rules: One-on-one paddle-and-ball match, Pong/Breakout-style duel. A single ball is served from the court centre toward a random side at the start of each rally. Each side defends one end of the court. If the ball passes a paddle and crosses that end's goal line, the opposite side scores 1 point, the ball resets to centre and is served again after a 1.5 s pause. Paddle hits and side-wall bounces do not score. First side to 7 points wins, and the game ends immediately with a win/lose message and a restart option. Ball speed starts at 8 m/s and rises 5% on each paddle hit, capped at 16 m/s, and resets after each point.
brief.arena: Walled court on a flat floor, about 16 m long (goal axis) by 10 m wide. Solid walls run along both long sides and bounce the ball. The two short ends are open goal lines, each with a goal sensor trigger behind the paddle. Player paddle (about 2.5 m wide, 0.4 m deep) sits 1 m in front of the south goal line. AI paddle sits the same distance in front of the north goal line. Paddles move only sideways along their end. The ball spawns at the court centre. Fixed overhead-angled camera showing the whole court. A score display is shown at the top of the screen.
brief.ai: The computer controls the north paddle. Each frame it moves sideways toward the ball's predicted x position when the ball is heading toward it, and drifts back to centre when the ball is heading away. Its max speed is capped at about 75% of the ball's lateral speed and its aim has a small reaction delay (about 0.15 s) and a small random offset, so it can be beaten with angled shots but still returns easy balls. It never leaves its end or passes through walls. Observable: the AI paddle tracks the ball, returns slow centred shots and sometimes misses fast angled ones.
brief.controls: move_left and move_right (A/D or Left/Right arrows, plus a gamepad left stick x axis): slide the player paddle sideways at up to 10 m/s, stopped at the side walls. Where the ball strikes the paddle sets its outgoing angle (centre hit goes straight, edge hit goes angled). restart (R or Enter): starts a new match after game over. pause (Esc): toggles pause.
brief.mood: Clean, readable neon-arcade look using simple geometric shapes: dark slate floor and walls with bright cyan trim, a cyan player paddle, a magenta AI paddle, and a glowing white ball with a short trail. Soft, even top light with a subtle glow on the goal lines. A small spark burst and a short thump sound on each paddle and wall hit, and a distinct chime on each goal.
